fields.meaning: Aspect ratio: sidewall height as a percent of section width

serviceDescription.definition: Load index plus speed rating. Tires of the same dimensional size can have different service descriptions.
serviceDescription.replacementRule: Meet or exceed the vehicle manufacturer specified load index and speed rating unless a manufacturer-approved exception applies.

loadRules: A higher tire load index does not increase the vehicle's legal or engineered load capacity.
Maximum sidewall pressure is not the same as the vehicle's recommended operating pressure.
Same dimensional size does not guarantee equivalent load capacity.

tubeConstruction.meaning: The tire is designed to operate without an inner tube on an appropriate tubeless rim; some specialty applications may still publish compatible tube references.

dateCode.meaning: Last four digits of the DOT/TIN date portion indicate week and year of manufacture.

commercialExamples.meaning: Commercial truck size with single/dual load indexes and speed symbol.

agExamples.meaning: VF category, 650 mm nominal section width, 60 aspect ratio, radial construction, 38-inch rim, load index 155, speed index D.
